meaning.en: A female given name, variant of Marissa.
meaning.vi: Một tên phụ nữ, biến thể của Marissa.

sentences.en: For the first series of Celebrity Fit Club, Marisa Peer served as psychologist while Dr. David Katz dispensed the medical advice.

sentences.en: You may want to search by the name of a famous model you like, such as Petra Nemcova, Gisele Bundchen or Marisa Miller.

sentences.en: Marisa Miller, one of the shortest Victoria's Secret Angels at only 5'8", became a model and an Angel in 2007.
